disposition.target: Recovery Workbench Error and Message Standard v4
disposition.change: In §4 add two new message IDs: (1) catalog load marks a v_ace_* view with a system of record other than ACE (AC11), English as in story §14 row MSG-P1-003; (2) no valid session, 'Your session has ended. Sign in again.'; Thai for both. Then repoint the story.
disposition.note: Standard v4 §4: MSG-P1-003 and MSG-P4-001 (sign-in with no Workbench role) have other triggers; no session message found there. No ID invented; story unchanged.

disposition.target: Recovery Workbench Error and Message Standard v4
disposition.change: Add a new P1 message ID, raised when a catalog load marks a v_ace_* view with a system of record other than ACE (AC11), English as in story §14 row MSG-P1-003, plus Thai; then replace MSG-P1-003 in the story with it.
disposition.note: Standard v4 §4 trigger (no, several, or no owner) differs from the story use, so the proposed fix calls for a new ID. The standard must allocate it; none invented, story unchanged.
